tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi pod dang po (oṃ )gyi dkar chags//

001 (oṃ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs rje btsun nā ro pas mdzad pa/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor sa chen gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs pa las thog mar byin rlabs kyi yi ge/ kha)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gcig phyi mchod mdor bsdus dang bcas pa/ ga)bskyed rim la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i yi ge/ nga )tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus kyi yi ge/ ca)tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i yi ge/ cha)sbyin sreg gi yi ge/ ja)mar me'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge/ nya)gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs rgyud kyi dum bu/ ta)gnod sbyin mo padma ti'i sgrub thabs/ tha)gnod sbyin padma ti'i sgrub thabs kyi zhal shes/ da)gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i khol po pa ta na'i sgrub thabs/ na)lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/ pa)sman chen po'i bcud len gyi gdams pa/ pha)sa chen gyi yi ge rnams kyi bsdus don brag phug pa'i gsung sgros so/ ba)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ ma)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs chung ba 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ tsa)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ tsha)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ dza)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len pa'i tshul rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ wa)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ blo gsal rgya mtshos// 002 (oṃ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mchog gi padmo bzhad pa'i dga' ston/ kha)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bstod pa ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/

003 (oṃ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnam bshad nyi zla seṅges mdzad pa/ ka)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad rje btsun byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa/ kha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam bshad dngos grub myur 'gugs zhes bya ba nyi zla bzang pos mdzad pa/ 004 (oṃ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bdag 'jug 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ ka)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi yi ge rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ kha)nā ro pa'i thugs kyi snying khu sa skya pa'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa bzhin rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bya ba'i tshul rje kun dga' bzang po'i gsung bzhin gung rus zin mdzad pa/ 005 (oṃ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ ka)mkha' spyod gsang ba'i sgo 'byed zhes bya ba/ kha)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sbyin sreg 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ 006 (oṃ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ 007 (oṃ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan/ dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ 008 (oṃ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sbyin sreg gi yi ge rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ kha)thar rtse paṇa chen gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhugs/ 009 (oṃ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa man ngag rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas bsgrigs pa/

ka)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig rje mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ kha)rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zin dris bzang dpal gyi brjed byang du byas pa bzhugs/ 010 (oṃ)rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ ka)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig gsal byed bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros yar klung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan pas zin bris su btab pa/ kha)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rdzogs rim yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid kyi zin bris/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang posamadzad pa/ ga)rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i man ngag sa skya pa bsod nams dbang phyug gi gsung rgyun bzhugs/ 011 (oṃ)dpal sdom drug pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bcud// dpa' mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i nye lam mchog /dpal ldan sa skya'i bla chen gser chos gang*// dpal mchog he ru ka dpal tshar pa rje'i// gsung gi bcud 'di 'di phyir phan 'dod rnams// brtson pas bsgrubs na na rga 'chi ba las// nges par legs grol grol ba mchog 'grub pas// zin bris 'di yang yang dag lam chen yin/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad/ ka)rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab bstan gyi gsung*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs rgyun gyi nyams len gyi rim pa mdor bsdus/ kha)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lus dkyil snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu/ ga)rje btsun yab yum la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'pho ba tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun/ nga )rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i gser chos chig brgyud ma/ blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad/ ca)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun dge slong ring mo bas zin bris su bkod pa/

cha)rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i mngon rtogs la brten nas sbyang gzhi sbyang tshul gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje'i gsung las byung ba/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zung 'brel du gtong tshul mthong grol lde mig za hor gyi bandes mdzad pa/ 012 (oṃ)rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi 'chad thabs/ dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zin bris so// ka)lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ kha)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag gi sgo nas sngags khrus nad thams cad la phan pa/ ga)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs/ nga )rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos/ dge slong ring mos/ ca)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gsung khrid kyi dmigs rim ni/ 013 (oṃ)mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len zhal shes dang bcas pa/ don grub dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ ka)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi zin bris/ 014 (oṃ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul/ ngag dbang bsod nams kyis mdzad/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya/ lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 015 (oṃ)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen yig gsal ba mkha' spyod dpal ster/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ ka)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi 'pho ba byed tshul bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so// blo gsal gyis sbyar ba'o// 016 (oṃ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gzhi bsnyen bya tshul dang gong ma'i gsung gsal bar bshad pa don gnyer can kun dga' bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sa chog sa lha dgyes pa'i dga' ston/

kha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i them skas/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o// 017 (oṃ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rtsa dbu ma'i khrid kyi chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ 018 (oṃ)rgyal chen ind+ra bhu ti'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// gser chos// ka)mi dbang chos gsum las/ las bcu'i gdams ngag bha rend+ra ru tsis mdzad pa/ kha)mi dbang chos gsum gyi 'grel pa zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs dang phag mo las bcu/ grags rgyan gsung*/ ga)sngags kyis de nyid byin gyis brlabs pa yis// lag tu blang ba'i rim pa 'dir 'chad bri/ grags rgyan gsung*/ nga )de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga gsal por bri/ grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/ ca)phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don rnams/ cha)phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ ja)phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs sa lugs kyi yi ge gung rus mdzad pa/ nya)i nd+ra mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklags chog tu bkod pa/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad/ ta)ind+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs/ bya bral bas mdzad pa'o// (nā ro mkha' spyod kyi pod gnyis pa (āḥ)pa'i dkar chag/) 019 (āḥ)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol 'debs gcig/ ka)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim brgyud 'debs bcas klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ kha)nā ro mkha' spyod brgyud pa rim gsum la gnas sbyar gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mos gus ku mud kha 'byed byin rlabs chu shel dbang po kun blos mdzad pa/ ga)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs bsdus pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa dang*/

tshar chen gyi mdzad pa'i pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston gnyis kyi kha skong rags rim rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdom pa/ kun blos so/ nga )bde mchog nyung ngu'i lung brgyud gsol 'debs bde chen mngon gyur/ kun blos so/ ca)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun khyer bsdus pa/ kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad/ cha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal go bde/ bya blal lhun grub kyis mdzad/ ja)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad klags pas myur du grub ces bya ba zab cing byin rlabs che ba khyad par can/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad/ nya)rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang*/ sa skya pa kun blos so/ ta)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'pho ba lhan cig tu bkod pa tshar chen gsung gi snying khu 'chi med 'bras ster/ sa skya pa kun blos so/ tha)gzhan la 'chi khar 'pho ba 'debs tshul lhag bsam rab dkar/ sa skya pa kun blos so/ 020 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ 021 (āḥ)dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsdo bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ ka)rnal 'byor ma'i sngags don gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsung lan/ 022 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid rim bla ma'i gsung sgros dngos grub myur mgyogs kyi pho nya/ bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la/ ngag dbang gis zin bris/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes kyi nyams len zab mo/ bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la/ ngag dbang gis zin bris/ kha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba'i zhal shes dang po yab la brten pa/ ga)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba'i zhal shes gnyis pa yum la brten pa/

bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la/ ngag dbang gis zin bris/ nga )rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa'i yig chung*/ ca)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i zhal shes yig chung*/ bla ma sa skya pa'i man ngag go cha)phyag rgya chen po dbu mar 'jug pa'i yig chung*/ ja)thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len gsang chen bcud kyi thig le/ nya)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang bzhi lus sgrigs kyi yig chung*/ ta)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang bzhi lus sgrigs mkha' spyod sgrub pa 'pho ba rnams kyi zhal shes kyi yig chung*/ tha)he ru ka yab yum zhal sbyor dang*/ yum rkyang la brten pa'i 'pho ba gser chos mal lo tsā ba'i man ngag sa chen gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// da)mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam/ tshar chen/ na)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis dge legs kyi dpal ster/ byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad/ 023 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing blang ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad/ 024 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma'i nyams len/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad/ 025 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su mchod phreng rgyas par bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa bsod nams rgyas byed*/ bya bral maṅga las so// 026 (āḥ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim dang mthun pa'i smon lam/ tshar chen/ ka)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis glo bo pas mdzad pa/ kha)rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i bstod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug/

bya bral ba sangs rgyas ming can gyis mdzad/ ga)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsol 'debs thugs rje myur bskul/ bya bral bas mdzad/ nga )rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i zhing gi bkod pa dang mthun par bstod pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/ bya bral lhun sgrub kyis mdzad/ ca)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i tshogs mchod bya tshul nyung ngu rnam gsal/ bya bral lhun grub kyis mdzad/ cha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod zab don nying khu/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad/ ja)dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu'i dgongs don bod skad du sdeb pa/ nya)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mchan btab/ 027 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas dus tha ma'i cho ga bya tshul 'khor 'das dge legs 'bar ba'i 'od can/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sa chog nyung du*/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad/ 028 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i yi ge mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad/

ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa sgrib pa rnam sel/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad/ kha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma la brten pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bklags pas don grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 029 (āḥ)thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad/ ka)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag zab mo gser chos chig brgyud ma/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad/ kha)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gser chos tshig brgyud ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i man ngag sogs zhal shes khag che ba 'ga' zhig sa lo chen po'i phyag dpe las logs su bkod pa/ ga)laṅka li ya'i bsgrub pa bya tshul bklags chog ma/ nga )ngor chen rdo rje'i 'chang gi phyag dpe'i khrod nas rnyed pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i yig rnying yid ches can/ ca)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gser yon dang bcas pa'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma ni/ kun blos/ cha)thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nye lam/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad/ ja)bde mchog yum rkyang gi 'pho ba chig brgyud gser chos kyi gdams pa mal lo tsā'i gsung la rje sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i nyams len gyi snying po/ nya)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma'i dris lan dogs dpyod kyi zin bris/ dge slong anandas mdzad/ ta)rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len snying po dril ba snyan rgyud gser gyi yang zhun zhes bya ba snod min la gsang ba'i chos so/ bya la lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 030 (āḥ)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga thar lam 'dren pa'i lcags kyu/

bya bral lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 031 (āḥ)tho bskyed chog gsal ba'i me long*/ bya bral lhun grub kyis mdzad/ ka)'da' kha ma'i zin dris gsal bar bkod pa/ bya bral lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 032 (āḥ)ind+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs/ bya bral lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 033 (āḥ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ ka)rnal 'byor ma'i ku sā li'i tshogs bsags kyi ngag 'don/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ kha)rnal 'byor ma'i lus dkyil ngag 'don ni/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ ga)rnal 'byor ma'i nyer mkho'i zin bris/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ 034 (āḥ)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len nag 'gros gsal ba'i me long*/ dge slong bya bral ba padma phrin las kyis mdzad/ ka)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zab gnad snying por bsdus pa mthong ba rab gsal/ dge slong bya bral ba padma phrin las kyis mdzad/ kha)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen yig bsdus pa dngos grub mchog ster/ dge slong bya bral ba padma phrin las kyis mdzad/ ga)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod tshogs gnyis myur 'grub/ dge slong bya bral ba padma phrin las kyis mdzad/ nga )nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs 'dod gsol dang smon lam kyi 'grel ba snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i snying khu/ dge slong bya bral ba padma phrin las kyis mdzad/ ca)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rgyun 'khyer dran gso gsal ba'i me long*/ dge slong bya bral ba padma phrin las kyis mdzad/ cha)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len snying por dril ba/ 'gyur med rdo rjes so/ 035 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklag chog tu bkod pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad/ 036 (āḥ)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa la lhan thabs nag 'gros su bkod pa/

037 (āḥ)rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khrid 'chad tshul sa chen thugs thig/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad/ 038 (āḥ)nges nges tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs skal ldan kun// bzang bzang mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas mchog che// myur myur bgrod phyir 'pho ba'i gdams pa mchog /legs legs yid bzhin nor bu'i them skas bzhugs/ lha ban mkhyen brtses mdzad/ 039 (āḥ)dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi tho yig glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ ka)dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ byin rlabs cho ga khrigs chags su bgod pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa bcas bzhugs so// (nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i pod gsum pa (hūm̐ )gi dkar chag/) 040 (hūm̐)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi lhan thabs dkyus su bcug pa nag 'gros bklag chog gsal ba'i me long*/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ 041 (hūm̐)rje btsun mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'i gdams ngag mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam/ blo gsal gsung*/ ka)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba'i nyams len mdor bsdus mkha' spyod myur lam/ blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa/ 042 (hūm̐)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos nyid dngos bstan gyi byin rlabs/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i snying thig bande dharama' bha dras mdzad pa/ kha)dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bkod pa/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa/

043 (hūm̐)rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba dang zhal shes kyi man ngag gung rus gsung la mnga' ris pa tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mchan bu byas pa'o// 044 (hūm̐)dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid myur lam rkang mgyogs sgrub pa'i gom stabs/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ ka)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ kha)nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don nor bu'i phreng ba/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ ga)rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ nga )mkha' spyod yum la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ ca)dpal sa skya'i gser chos lugs kyi nā ro mkha' spyod la brten pa'i 'pho ba 'od gsal bar dor bcas pa'i nyams len zab gnad btus pa'i bdud rtsi/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ cha)gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i zegs ma/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ ja)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mar me'i sreg blugs nyung ngu rab gsal/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa'o// 045 (hūm̐)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i bka' khrid kyi zin bris khyab bdag bla ma'i zhal lung snying gi mun sel gsang chen grub pa'i mchog sbyin/ dge slong 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ 046 (hūm̐)dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor mar brten pa'i gcod yul gyi gdams pa khyer bde mkha' 'gro'i snying gi thig bcud/ 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/

ka)rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i ku sā li'i tshogs bsags dang 'brel bar gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa gcod pa'i man ngag gnad kyi spu gri/ byams pa phrin las yon tan gyis mdzad pa/ 047 (hūm̐)rje btsun mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs rim khyer bde kun tshang*/ gzim 'og sprul 'dzin byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin na las kyis mdzad pa/ 048 (hūm̐)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs bya tshul tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len ltar bkrags chog tu bkod pa bde chen sprin sgra/ zhwa lu ba blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa/ 049 (hūm̐)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid kyi chos nyid dngos ston zhes pa'i nyams len nyung bsdus/ zhwa lu ba blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rim gnyis nyams su len pa'i gegs sel khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i thugs thig zhwa lu ba blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa/ 050 (hūm̐)grub chen mai tri pa'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams/ gser chos// ka)mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ kun dga'i ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// kha)grub chen mai tri pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklags pas grub par bkod pa mkha' spyod grub pa'i rgyan/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ ga)grub chen mai tri pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklags pas grub par bkod pa mkha' spyod grub pa'i rgyan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'o// 051 (hūm̐ dang*/ rgyud btus pod shrī/)dpal ldanam̐ nā rom̐ ta pa'i la gyi lung*// tshad ma bzhi ldan mkham̐' spyodam̐ dga' ma'i lam/

brgyud ldan zhal rlangs ma yal snying gi thig mkha' spyod 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mdzes rgyan 'di// sprang chal snyom las mkhan gyi snying bcud de// dam med dbang khrid ma thob rtog ge ba// 'di snang zu lum mkhan gyi spyod yul min// de phyir dpal mgon dur khrod mgon po yis// rab dmar spyan gsum 'khyugs la dus drug gzigs// dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa gdengs sra brtan rgya/ sa ma yaḥ: btsun pa ngag dbang dam chos rgya mtsho blo bzang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma'am/ ming gzhan tshangs sras zla ba 'chi med lang tshor 'bod pa'i snyoms las pas mdzad pa'o// 052 (hūm̐ dang*/ mkhyen brtse bka' 'bum ca nang*/)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i 'khrid kyi 'chad thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ 053 (hūm̐ dang*/ mkhyen brtse bka' 'bum ca nang*/)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan/ dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa la/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mchan can/ ka)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi zur 'debs nyung gsal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ kha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs mdor bsdus pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ ga )rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs mdor bsdus dang 'brel ba'i nyams len mkha' spyod gsang lam mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ nga )rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs snying por dril ba mkha' spyod lam bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ ca)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang la nyer mkho'i lhan thabs mkha' spyod grub ster/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ cha)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ ja)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgom bzlas shin tu bsdus pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ nya)rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs nyung gsal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ ta)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten pa'i rgyun gyi tshogs mchod mdor bsdus pa bsod nams rtag pa dam pa'i sprin chen/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ tha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i tshogs mchod bya tshul mdor bsdus pa bsod nams sprin gyi gru char/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ da)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa mkha' spyod ḍā ki dgyes pa'i rol mo/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ na)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i rdo rje'i glu bde chen rtag pa dam pa'i sprin gyi rol mo/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ pa)tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan gyi smon lam dpa' bo dang ḍā ki dgyes pa'i glu gar/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ pha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bkra shis dge legs mchog sbyin/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ ba)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ ma)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud 'debs bsdus pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ tsa)bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs lam rim dang 'brel ba mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ tsha)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams sprin gyi rol mo/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ 054(hūm̐)mkha' spyod brgyud 'debs zhal skong ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'o// 055 nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa shin tu bsdus pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'o// 056 nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'o// 057 nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ bco brgyad khri chen gyis mdzad pa'o// 058 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa la bla brgyud kha skong sa lugs ltar ro// 059 bla brgyud kha skong nā lend+ra ltar du yin/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mchog gi padmo bzhad pa'i dga' ston/ tshar chen gsung*/

060 bla brgyud kha skong sman mchod nā lend+ra ltar du yin/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa la bla brgyud kha skong nā lend+ra lugs ltar ro// 061 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi lhan thabs dkyus su bcug pa nag 'gros bklag chog gsal ba'i me long*/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa la bla brgyud dang sman mchod kha skong nā lend+ra lugs ltar ro// 062 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad par lhan thabs nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis nag 'gros mdzad pa'o// 063 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga thar lam 'dren pa'i lcags kyu/ lhun grub kyis mdzad/ 064 'di ni lus dkyil dang bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa med pa'i rgyun khyer rgyas pa'o/ ༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 065 ༈ /mkha' spyod ma'i lus dkyil/ 066 ༈ /thun min bsam mi khyab/ 067 ༈ /gnyis pa chags bral gyi rnal 'byor la/ 068 ༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga'i rnam bshad lung dang rigs pa'i gter mdzod/ dge 'phel rin po che'am/ 'jam dbyangs kun bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'o// ༈ bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las gu rus spel ba'o/// /༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
